words.said: Research: Zenod as a company memory, one voice-note mailbox every employee sends ideas to, AI sorts them and bubbles things up; one page on who would buy it, what exists, how it differs from EpicTeam
words.where: the row's ask (no quote of his found)
words.how: Evidence page shows the IN, ZENOD DOES, OUT company memory diagram, buyers, what-exists table, and How it differs section; recommendation box at the end.

visual.summary: Both widths open with the punchline box and a three-column diagram, tables and recommendation follow; no sideways overflow and the page renders fully.

held: ambiguous: "The team recommends yes" with the button "Yes: say which business in your reply, you ask its owner, the team does the rest" – a stranger could not tell whether a yes starts the test now or whether he still has to approve the tester invite first.
